deviations.what: press toasts a constant text on all eleven tiles - composed on the client, so no press needs a round-trip.

onFormSubmit sets every tile to Loading and back to Loaded after the entered number of seconds. The tile state is one bound property here and the framework's START_TIMER brings it back, so the same two states are shown; the original reads the seconds off the Input imperatively, the port has them two-way bound.
The two sample images (the SAP logo tile image and the profile picture) are the sample's own test-resources files, re-hosted on sdk.openui5.org.

GenericTile frameType="OneByHalf" and frameType="TwoByHalf" are @since 1.83, url is @since 1.76 and appShortcut / systemInfo are @since 1.92 - all newer than the 1.71 floor. The sample is built on exactly these members (the launch-tile shapes, the tile as a link and the two info lines), so they are kept and the port is filed under src/02.
The loading-state timer and the eleven tile presses are unverified in a running system.

The sample's manifest loads a style.css whose single rule is `.tileLayout { float: left; }`, and all eleven tiles carry that class. The port injects the rule through a core:HTML style leaf (the app-028 form) - without it the class resolves to nothing and the launch tiles stack vertically instead of floating into a tile wall.
